_comment: Grimdex labor-split policy. Copy to config/models.json and edit for your rig. See universal/playbooks/labor-split.md. availability: {state: available|scarce|out|unknown, as_of, window: 5h|weekly|monthly|none, valid_until (the known reset time, optional), source: manual|atomickestrel, detail}; a reading expires at valid_until, else as_of + policy.availability_fallback_hours (short for 5h windows, long otherwise), then counts as unknown. Absent = available. AtomicKestrel, if installed, writes these (grimdex-d052). invoke: claude-subagent:<model> | cli:<binary> | plugin:<name>. gate: a restriction only — must start with explicit-call-only (optionally '; <condition>'); gated workers are picked only by name. pool: free-text quota/billing note, never filters.

builder.pool: describe its quota pool here (informational; never filters)

policy._builder_chain_comment: builder_chain is the bulk-code order of preference, walked top down: the first entry that is an available candidate gets the work, so nothing hard-codes a builder that may go away. Plain names are worker names; two tokens are computed at run time and stand for the free and the priced models of one provider: '@cc-free-best' = the provider's models whose `offer.free` is true, '@cc-deal-best' = the rest of its `offer`-carrying models (deals, contributor tier). A token only offers models that passed at least 90% of their hidden tests and are available-or-scarce now, best first (pass rate, then speed) — so the list may be shorter than it looks, and an entry nobody knows is skipped rather than fatal. default_builder above is still the fallback when there is no chain.
